title: Industry Consulting Snr. Consultant
description:

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Technical Program Manager, Data ScienceSenior Technical Program Manager  
  
Overview:  
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights Data Science team, part of the Services organization, is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive the delivery of innovative, data-driven solutions at scale.  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on and collaborative execution leader who can operate with a high degree of autonomy, bring structure to ambiguous and complex initiatives, and drive predictable outcomes across multiple teams and stakeholders. The Senior TPM will lead day-to-day program execution, manage cross-team dependencies, and partner closely with engineering, product, and stakeholder teams across Mastercard to ensure alignment and delivery.  
Our team builds high-performance analytics platforms that enable businesses around the world to unlock greater value from their data and make smarter decisions. This role will ensure work is clearly defined, appropriately sized, prioritized, tracked, and delivered with consistency, transparency, and accountability across teams.  
This role requires the ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels by translating priorities into executable plans, proactively identifying risks, solving problems, and continuously improving how teams plan, govern, and deliver work.  
This is a hybrid position based in Pune, requiring three days per week onsite.  
  
Role:  

* Own end-to-end execution of Data Science initiatives, ensuring work is clearly scoped, prioritized, planned, tracked, and delivered.
* Build and maintain integrated program plans that account for milestones, sequencing, dependencies, constraints, risks, and contingency planning.
* Drive accountability across engineering, product, stakeholder, and partner teams by ensuring owners, actions, decisions, blockers, and delivery commitments are clear and actively managed.
* Partner across Mastercard to align priorities, manage dependencies, remove blockers, and ensure consistent progress toward delivery outcomes.
* Bring sufficient technical depth to understand the program domain, participate in solution discussions, ask effective questions, and help engineering teams navigate blockers without being expected to write code.
* Secures resources, scopes efforts, outlines priorities and establishes delivery milestones
* Proactively manage the end-to-end delivery of data science work through the organization and all dependent organizations, reporting out progress, ensuring dependencies are covered, overseeing the gaps between teams, processes, and systems, while removing all blocking issues leading to a successful delivery. Accelerates progress by driving crisp, timely decisions
* Serve as the source of truth for program status, providing clear, concise, and data-driven updates to the right audiences at the right time.
* Proactively identify risks, issues, and execution gaps, escalate when appropriate, and drive timely decisions to protect delivery timelines.
* Define and track execution metrics that improve transparency, predictability, and accountability across the program.
* Lead effective operating mechanisms, including planning sessions, status reviews, dependency reviews, risk reviews, and retrospectives.
* Drive alignment across a portfolio of initiatives by evaluating business and technical trade-offs and partnering across teams to optimize execution approaches, technology adoption, and operating models.
* Continuously improve how teams plan, govern, measure, and deliver work by identifying process gaps and driving practical improvements.

  
All About You:  

* Proven experience delivering complex technology projects as a Technical Program Manager, Technical Project Manager, or similar role.
* Understanding of Agile and hybrid delivery models, the software development lifecycle, and how to drive execution across multiple engineering teams.
* Technical depth and judgment to navigate ambiguity, structure complex technical problems, and turn loosely defined priorities into executable plans.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
* Systems-level thinking with the ability to partner with engineering on architecture, APIs, and platform decisions.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to use metrics, dashboards, and delivery health indicators to improve transparency, predictability, and program outcomes.
* Passionate about continuous improvement and have experience improving team processes, operating mechanisms, delivery quality, and accountability.
* Strong servant leadership, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with a focus on enabling teams and fostering collaboration.
* Hands-on curiosity and willingness to dive deep into platform capabilities, underlying technologies, and evolving industry trends.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Aha!, Power BI, EasyBI, MS Project, or similar project management and collaboration platforms.
* Experience driving organizational change, adoption, and continuous process improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong executive presence.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Data Science Intern
description:
**Job Title:** Data Science Intern  
**Company:** WeIntern Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra (Remote / Work From Home)  
**Job Type:** Internship  
**Duration:** 3–6 Months

About WeIntern Pvt. Ltd.

WeIntern Pvt. Ltd. offers internship opportunities for students and aspiring professionals to develop industry-relevant skills through practical learning and project-based experience.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Science Intern who is passionate about working with data, identifying patterns, and generating meaningful insights.

Roles and Responsibilities

* Collect, clean, transform, and analyze structured datasets.
* Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and patterns.
* Use Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib for data analysis and visualization.
* Write SQL queries to retrieve, filter, and manipulate data.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings.
* Apply basic statistical techniques to support data-driven decisions.
* Assist in developing predictive models and data science solutions.
* Identify data quality issues and recommend improvements.
* Maintain documentation of analysis, methodologies, and project results.

Eligibility Criteria

* Students, freshers, and candidates interested in Data Science may apply.
* Basic knowledge of Python programming.
* Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, and data visualization is preferred.
* Basic understanding of statistics and probability.
* Knowledge of SQL and database concepts is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or Machine Learning is desirable.
* Good analytical, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn new tools and complete assigned projects.

What You Will Gain

* Practical experience in data analysis and exploratory data analysis.
* Exposure to real-world datasets and data science workflows.
* Experience with Python, SQL, and visualization tools.
* Opportunities to develop analytical and reporting skills.
* Project-based learning and feedback on technical assignments.
* Experience collaborating in a remote working environment.

Internship Details

* **Work Mode:** Online / Work From Home
* **Duration:** 3–6 Months
* **Location:** Pune, Maharashtra

**Company:** WeIntern Pvt. Ltd.  
**Office Address:** B Wing, 3rd Floor, Office No. 5, City Vista, Fountain Road, Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra.

Learn. Build. Experience. Grow.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Vice President, Data Scientist
description:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Data Scientist to join our AI Hub team. This role is located in Pune.

**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Design and develop Python-based margin and collateral optimization solutions.
* Extend rule engine for rules related to eligibility, concentration limits, and liquidity addon etc.
* Build optimization algorithms for collateral allocation, substitution, and funding cost reduction.
* Develop analytics for IM, VM, SIMM, haircuts, eligibility, concentration limits, and liquidity optimization.
* Integrate pricing, risk, and collateral platforms through APIs and distributed processing frameworks.
* Partner with Quant, Risk, and Operations teams to deliver scalable production solutions.
* Optimize application performance, automation, and cloud-native deployments.

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**

* 10+ years of Python development experience in Capital Markets.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, REST APIs, and Git.
* Experience with optimization libraries such as OR-Tools, Pyomo, CVXPY, PuLP, Gurobi, or CPLEX.
* Good understanding of derivatives, collateral management, repo, securities financing, and margin methodologies (SIMM, IM/VM).
* Exposure to cloud technologies, Docker/Kubernetes, and distributed processing is preferred.

Preferred Domain Experience

* Margin & Collateral Management
* Collateral Optimization
* Treasury & Liquidity Management
* Repo & Securities Lending
* OTC Derivatives (IRS, FX, Credit, Equity)
* Capital Markets Risk & Analytics

Preferred Background

Candidates from investment banks, custodian banks, CCPs, fintechs, or collateral management platforms with hands-on experience in optimization, quantitative analytics, and Capital Markets technology.

title: Associate Data Scientist – Modeling, Analytics & Pipelines
description:
Aera Technology is a pioneer in the growing category of Decision Intelligence Platforms and a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for 2026– the technology to digitize, augment, and automate decision\-making processes with AI and machine learning. Through our AI decision automation platform, Aera Decision Cloud™, we are helping the best\-known brands in the world make smarter, faster decisions.  



The need for decision intelligence has never been greater. The digitization of the economy has introduced a paradox: Companies today are awash in data, yet the velocity, volume, and complexity of that information is outpacing their ability to make decisions with the speed and precision that today’s business environment demands. Decision intelligence represents the critical shift — moving from people making decisions with machine support to machines making decisions guided by people. As the digital economy accelerates into an era defined by agentic AI, this shift has become a competitive necessity, enabling organizations to act faster, adapt with confidence, and unlock value once beyond reach.  



Aera Technology is at the forefront of this agentic revolution. Recognized by IDC as a leader in decision intelligence and cited by Gartner in its Market Guide for Decision Intelligence, we’re the trusted choice of global market leaders. Built on a comprehensive and composable platform, Aera empowers organizations to optimize and automate all types of decisions, across every business area.  

We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist who is exceptional at understanding data, extracting insights, and turning those insights into robust machine learning or statistical models. You will own the full modeling workflow from exploratory analysis and feature engineering through to building reproducible pipelines that can be deployed into production for our customers.  

  

  

### **Responsibilities**


* Partner with product and domain experts to translate ambiguous business questions into clear analytical and modeling problems.
* Perform deep exploratory data analysis (EDA) on complex, noisy, and often incomplete datasets; validate data quality, uncover patterns, and frame hypotheses.
* Design and implement features, select appropriate modeling approaches (e.g., regression, tree\-based models, time series, clustering), and benchmark alternatives.
* Write clean, well\-structured Python code and notebooks for interactive analysis, experimentation, and result communication.
* Build end‑to‑end data and modeling pipelines (data extraction, preprocessing, feature generation, model training, evaluation, and inference) that are modular, testable, and reproducible.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to productionize models on the Aera platform, including packaging, versioning, monitoring, and validation.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders using visualizations, written narratives, and live walkthroughs.



### **About You**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* 1–3 years of experience in data science, data analysis, or ML engineering, or equivalent strong project/internship experience.
* Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis: pandas, NumPy, and common scientific/ML libraries (e.g., scikit‑learn; familiarity with TensorFlow/PyTorch is a plus).
* Solid experience with EDA and statistical analysis; comfortable working in notebooks to iteratively explore data and build intuition.
* Good working knowledge of SQL and data manipulation; able to join, aggregate, and transform data from multiple sources.
* Experience structuring code into reusable components, applying basic software engineering practices (version control, testing, documentation).
* Strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving skills, with a bias for clear, data‑backed decision making.

  



### **Nice to have**

* Exposure to production ML/analytics systems (scheduling, APIs, CI/CD, monitoring).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and distributed data frameworks (e.g., Spark).
* Domain experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations.
  


If you share our passion for building a sustainable, intelligent, and efficient world, you’re in the right place. Established in 2017 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, we're a series D start\-up, with teams in Mountain View, San Francisco (California), Bucharest and Cluj\-Napoca (Romania), Paris (France), Munich (Germany), London (UK), Pune (India), and Sydney (Australia). BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist with deep experience in B2B SaaS to lead the development of advanced analytics, predictive models, and AI\-driven insights that improve business performance and customer outcomes. This role will partner closely with teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Data teams to solve high\-impact business problems using data science.
The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and business analytics, combined with a practical understanding of key SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, retention, expansion, pipeline conversion, customer health, and product adoption. This person must be able to move fluently between technical depth and business context, translating complex data into actionable recommendations that influence strategy and execution.
Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success:
* Develop and deploy predictive and prescriptive models to solve critical business problems across the B2B SaaS lifecycle.


* Build data science solutions for use cases such as customer churn prediction, upsell propensity, lead scoring, pipeline forecasting, product adoption, customer segmentation, pricing optimization, and customer health scoring.


* Partner with Sales, Operations, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities where data science can improve growth, retention, and operational efficiency.


* Design and analyze experiments, A/B tests, and quasi\-experimental studies to measure the impact of product, marketing, and sales initiatives.


* Apply statistical methods and machine learning techniques to large, complex datasets from CRM, product telemetry, marketing, support, finance, and customer systems.


* Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches and communicate findings clearly to executive and cross\-functional stakeholders.


* Collaborate with data engineers, analytics engineers, BI teams, and architects to ensure scalable data pipelines and production\-ready modeling workflows.


* Monitor model performance, validate assumptions, and continuously improve model accuracy, explainability, and business relevance.


* Support the development of self\-service insights, reusable data science assets, and scalable frameworks for decision\-making.


* Document methodologies, assumptions, and business impact in a clear and reproducible manner.


To ensure you’re set up for success, you will bring the following skillset \& experience:
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.


* 8\+ years of experience in data science \& machine learning, with significant experience in B2B SaaS environments.


* Strong expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, experimentation, and causal analysis.


* Strong proficiency in Python and advanced SQL skills.


* Experience working with large\-scale business, sales, and product datasets, including CRM, telemetry, subscription, and customer data.


* Deep understanding of B2B SaaS business models and core metrics such as ARR, MRR, churn, retention, expansion, NRR, CAC, LTV, conversion, and product usage/adoption.


* Hands\-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and modern AI frameworks such as OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar tools.


* Familiarity with RAG, prompt engineering, model evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices for enterprise\-ready AI solutions.


* Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery


* Experience in subscription analytics, revenue analytics, product\-led growth, or customer lifecycle modeling.


* Experience building models that support GTM, Product, or Customer Success decision\-making.


* Strong ability to communicate technical findings to non\-technical audiences and influence business decisions.


* Experience working cross\-functionally in fast\-paced, matrixed environments.


* Familiarity with GenAI or AI\-enabled analytical workflows is a plus.


* Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker

  

  

Core Skills:
* Machine Learning


* Statistical Modeling


* Forecasting


* Experimentation and A/B Testing


* Customer Churn and Retention Analytics


* Product Adoption Analytics


* Revenue and Growth Analytics


* Segmentation and Propensity Modeling


* Python


* SQL


* Applied AI / Generative AI


* Large Language Models (LLMs) / Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)


* Data Storytelling


* Cross\-Functional Business Partnership

  

  

What Success Looks Like:
Success in this role means delivering data science solutions that create measurable business impact. This includes improving customer retention, accelerating growth, increasing forecast accuracy, identifying high\-value opportunities, and enabling smarter decisions across the B2B SaaS customer lifecycle. The successful candidate will combine strong technical rigor with business judgment and will help embed data science into everyday decision\-making across the organization.
**Our commitment to you!**

  

BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000\+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!

  

  

If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!
